title: Brackenvale
content: Rolling bracken and sheep-walks between the river and the hills, crossed by the old drove road. Wide, open and empty after dark.

exits.name: The drove road south
exits.description: The old road down to the toll bridge and the town beyond.

exits.name: The hill track
exits.description: A steep track up to the watchtower on Kestrel Rise.

exits.name: The reed path
exits.description: A raised path of packed reed that leads into the mire.

exits.name: The mine road
exits.description: A rutted cart road up to the Copperdeep workings.

title: Lantern Ford
content: A small market town of grey stone around a ford on the river Lisk, ringed by iron lanterns on tall posts. Its square holds a well, a market cross and too many worried faces.

exits.name: The Oxbow's door
exits.description: A low oak door under a painted sign of a sleeping ox.

exits.name: Chapel Lane
exits.description: A narrow lane up to the chapel and its bell tower.

exits.name: The bridge road
exits.description: The road north out of town to the old toll bridge.

exits.name: The mill lane
exits.description: A lane along the river to the mill.

title: The Drowsy Oxbow
content: The town's only inn: low beams, a wide hearth, a cellar of cider and a landlady who hears everything.

exits.name: The front door
exits.description: Back out to the square.

title: The Chapel of the Quiet Bell
content: A small chapel whose great bell has not been rung in living memory. The Ford Lantern burns in a niche by the altar, and the crypt is older than the chapel above it.

exits.name: Chapel Lane
exits.description: Down the lane to the square.

exits.name: The crypt stair
exits.description: A worn stair behind a loose flagstone in the crypt, cold air rising from below.

title: The Mill of Seven Wheels
content: A tall timber mill with seven water-wheels turning in the race. The miller is laid up with a fever and his apprentice runs the place alone.

exits.name: The mill lane
exits.description: Back along the river to town.

title: The Old Toll Bridge
content: A humped stone bridge over the Lisk with a toll house at its town end. The toll is a copper a head, and the keeper takes it whatever the hour.

exits.name: The bridge road
exits.description: South into Lantern Ford.

exits.name: The drove road north
exits.description: Across the bridge and out into the open vale.

title: The Watchtower on Kestrel Rise
content: A ruined signal tower on the highest hill in the vale. From its top you can see the whole ring of lanterns, and which ones are dark.

exits.name: The hill track
exits.description: Down the steep track to the vale.

title: Ashfen Mire
content: Black water, grey reeds and stilt-houses on the far islands. Fog rises here every autumn evening; the Mire Kin know which paths stay firm.

exits.name: The reed path
exits.description: The raised path back to the open vale.

exits.name: The barrow door
exits.description: A slab of grey stone in a mound at the mire's edge, carved with three veiled figures.

title: The Barrow of the Grey Sisters
content: Three stone biers in a vaulted chamber, each with an iron lantern at its foot. Two of the lanterns are dark.

exits.name: The barrow door
exits.description: The carved slab out to the mire.

exits.name: The crypt stair
exits.description: A worn stair climbing toward the chapel above.

title: The Copperdeep Workings
content: Spoil heaps, a winding house and a shaft into the hill. No ore cart has come down in three days, and the Ledger House has posted guards at the gate.

exits.name: The mine road
exits.description: The rutted road back down to the vale.
